videos.title: Does Age Matter More Than Money In Marriage? | Nigerian’s Talk | Season 8 | Episode 5
videos.headline: Does Age Matter More Than Money In Marriage? | Nigerian’s Talk | Season 8 | Episode 5
videos.description:
his episode of Nigerians Talks Season 8 explores the conversation around marriage and financial independence, how one impacts the other and the different manner in which life decisions play out in women versus men.
In this episode, the guests discuss the various angles to this topic including how parents need to let their children decide who they want to be, the reality of pursuing your life’s ambition while also minding your biological clock and the place of consent and maturity in determining readiness for partnership in marriage.

Let us know your thoughts in the comments as this conversation proceeds.

Watch, listen, and join the conversation.

videos.title: Ademola Speaks On What “Real love” Is | One More Thing
videos.headline: Ademola Speaks On What “Real love” Is | One More Thing
videos.description:
In this episode of One More Thing, Lulu Manuel sits down with actor Adémólá Adedoyin for an honest conversation about his acting career, love, relationships, and finding roles that challenge him.

Adémólá talks about some of his most memorable roles in films like October 1 and Breath of Life, and why he prefers playing complex characters over simply being cast as the “fine boy.”

The conversation also gets personal as Adémólá shares his thoughts on love, attraction, and relationships. He also takes on fun pop questions and movie trivias. Watch and Enjoy.
